name: Test
purpose: Run the quality gates a project actually declared and report their real results, keeping passed, failed, unavailable, and unrun distinct.
prerequisites: A resolved project declaration, so every enabled gate has a command.
A working tree in the state that is meant to be tested.
steps: Read the resolved commands rather than inventing one.
Run each enabled gate in the declared order.
Record the exit status and the relevant output for each gate.
Report a gate with no command as unavailable, never as passed.
Report a gate that was not run as unrun, never as passed.
Summarize which gates ran, which failed, and what the failure was.
outputs: A per-gate result of passed, failed, unavailable, or unrun.
verification: Every reported result corresponds to a command that actually ran.
No gate is marked passed because it was skipped, disabled, or substituted.
escalation: A declared command does not exist; report it unavailable rather than substituting another.
A gate needs credentials, a database, or a network service that policy denies.
